reportedIssues: Cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel are not aligned to a common baseline — the Green Bowl Poké image is shorter and sits higher, Smash Bros Burgers is pushed lower, so titles and delivery prices appear at three different vertical positions.
The '15–25 min' badge on the Green Bowl Poké card is white text/pill on a very light image background, giving very poor contrast compared to the same badge on the darker cards.
The third carousel card's title 'Trattoria Piccol…' is hard-clipped by the screen edge with no ellipsis or peek affordance, and its image bleeds off-screen inconsistently with the other cards.
Favorite (heart) icons are styled inconsistently in 'Popular right now': the first card's heart has no background circle while the second card's heart sits on a dark circular backdrop.
The second 'Popular right now' card is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar, hiding its name and details with no visual hint that more content follows.
The category chip row is clipped mid-chip at the right edge, so the partially visible filter is unreadable and gives a broken rather than scrollable impression.

'Fastest near you' cards show only ETA and delivery fee, while 'Popular right now' cards show rating, cuisine and ETA, making the two sections feel inconsistent and leaving the top cards information-poor.
